sentences.text: Korora was a relatively small and slender penguin, similar in size to larger crested penguins. The genus name Korora comes from the Māori word for the little penguin.
This animal belongs to the bird order Sphenisciformes.
Brian Marples described Korora in 1952 based on a tarsometatarsus fossil collected from the Hakataramea Valley in New Zealand's South Island.
The species name oliveri honors Walter Oliver, a former director of the Dominion Museum.
Korora fossils date from the Late Oligocene to the Early Miocene. Korora lived between 25.2 and 21.7 million years ago during the Chattian to Aquitanian stages.
